scope: Accepted human ingress companion, atomic receipt/root capture, explicit installed facade and durable drain/retention guards.

baselineDiagnostic.repair: Private mocked process/pane tests use inert /bin/true as the tmux executable path; no runtime or real pane is started.

boundaries: Owned web producers provide an explicit ephemeral guest tier; strict stored receipt shape is unchanged. Missing fact and copied/serialized lookalikes refuse capture.
Plain recognized account identity grants no approval; guest precedence and unknown ingress stay outside.
Actual Fleet facade chooses the explicit factory only through the installed policy predicate and then never reads/copies lifetime origin. Missing installed owner refuses legacy fallback.
Receipt and immutable root/audience companion commit together; a previously bound legacy receipt cannot be backfilled after input.
Indexed pending human references block F and E retirement, survive age pruning and use correct FK deletion order.
Privileged current-admin checks also cover Free/restricted and guest contexts; a guest cannot borrow current native admin authority. Ordinary contact semantics remain unchanged.
Final-write registration, Classic SDK admission-basis capture/current-access factory, controlled relaunch and full-mode installation remain unfinished. No live activation.
